decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby approved shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (HP-D1-06 (Rev D1), HP-D1-07 (Rev D1), HP-D1-08 (Rev D1), HP-D1-09 (Rev D1), HP-D1-10 (Rev D1), HP-D1-11 (Rev D1), received 01 May 2014) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby approved shall match those used in the existing building or shall be as specified in the application.
description: Increase height of roof on existing rear extension, increase the pitch of the existing side extension, install new roof lights and replace existing timber framing to first floor rear balcony with glass.
